<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>TimeSyncher Vacation Add-ons</title>
  <script src="https://js.stripe.com/v3/"></script>
  <style>
    :root { color-scheme: dark; --gold:#f5d37b; --bg:#070706; --panel:#12110f; --line:rgba(245,211,123,.26); --text:#fffaf0; --muted:#cfc2a9; --ok:#8ee7d8; --bad:#ffb3ab; --field:#080807; }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    body { margin:0; min-height:100vh; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif; background:var(--bg); color:var(--text); padding:24px; }
    main { width:min(1040px,100%); margin:0 auto; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 360px; gap:20px; align-items:start; }
    section, aside { border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--panel); border-radius:8px; padding:24px; box-shadow:0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.28); }
    .brand { font-family: Georgia, serif; color:var(--gold); letter-spacing:.12em; text-transform:uppercase; font-size:14px; margin-bottom:18px; }
    h1 { font-family: Georgia, serif; font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,46px); line-height:1; margin:0 0 10px; color:var(--gold); letter-spacing:0; }
    h2 { font-size:18px; margin:0 0 14px; color:var(--gold); letter-spacing:0; }
    p { color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; margin:0 0 14px; }
    form { display:grid; gap:16px; margin-top:18px; }
    fieldset { border:0; padding:0; margin:0; display:grid; gap:14px; }
    legend { color:var(--gold); font-weight:900; margin-bottom:10px; }
    label { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--gold); font-weight:800; font-size:13px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; }
    input { width:100%; border:1px solid rgba(245,211,123,.28); border-radius:8px; padding:13px 14px; background:var(--field); color:var(--text); font:inherit; min-width:0; }
    input::placeholder { color:rgba(207,194,169,.62); }
    .row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:12px; }
    .card-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.5fr .8fr .7fr; gap:12px; }
    .summary, .choices { display:grid; gap:12px; }
    .summary-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(245,211,123,.14); padding-bottom:12px; color:var(--muted); }
    .summary-row strong { color:var(--text); }
    .total { font-size:22px; color:var(--gold); }
    .access-total { border:1px solid rgba(245,211,123,.28); border-radius:8px; padding:14px; background:rgba(245,211,123,.08); }
    .choice { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; gap:12px; align-items:start; border:1px solid rgba(245,211,123,.22); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; background:rgba(245,211,123,.055); color:var(--muted); }
    .choice input { width:auto; margin-top:3px; }
    .choice b { display:block; color:var(--gold); }
    .choice small { display:block; margin-top:3px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.35; }
    .choice strong { color:var(--text); white-space:nowrap; }
    button { border:0; border-radius:8px; padding:14px 18px; background:var(--gold); color:#080604; font-weight:900; cursor:pointer; font:inherit; }
    button:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:not-allowed; }
    .status { display:none; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; color:var(--muted); }
    .status.show { display:block; }
    .status.error { border-color:rgba(255,179,171,.55); color:var(--bad); }
    .status.ok { border-color:rgba(142,231,216,.5); color:var(--ok); }
    .notice { border:1px solid rgba(245,211,123,.2); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; color:var(--muted); background:rgba(245,211,123,.06); }
    .hidden { display:none !important; }
    #paymentElement { border:1px solid rgba(245,211,123,.2); border-radius:8px; padding:12px; background:#11100d; }
    @media (max-width:860px) { body { padding:14px; } main { grid-template-columns:1fr; } section, aside { padding:18px; } }
    @media (max-width:640px) { .row, .card-row { grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
